title: Language is blank for some members, so the admin can't tell what language they'll get
what_happens: Rows with a saved language show "EN"/"ES"; rows without one show nothing. The help text above says such numbers default by country (+506 Spanish, else English), but the row doesn't show that.
who_hurts: An admin checking who gets which language before sending invites has to work out the default in their head for each blank row.
suggested_fix: Show the effective language for every row, muted with "(auto)" when it is the default. src/app/admin/lists/[id]/page.tsx:80-82.
rule: opinion backed by the page's own help text
